data.body: **[P2] Accept verified worker retirement as settlement evidence.** A worker retired at its deadline cannot emit `WRAPPER_RETURN` or `WRAPPER_RAISE`. `evidence.deadline()` explicitly permits this outcome, but this condition remains false even after recovery probes establish full capacity in the original environment. Teardown then fails permanently, and `configuration['pending']` causes subsequent cases to fail during setup. Recognize independently verified retirement using request/process identity and recovery evidence, while continuing to reject workers whose termination is unproven. Add a test covering retirement without a final wrapper diagnostic.
